subject_variants: A free handout for your students
Something free for your {{org_name}} graduates
sequence.body:
Hello,

I put together a one-page handout called "Launching your trade business: first 5 steps" for people finishing license prep — the kind of thing that's useful the week they pass the exam and start looking for their first jobs. I'd like to send it to {{org_name}} for free, no strings attached.

Reply "send it" and I'll email the PDF, or I'll mail printed copies to your office, free.

{{signer_name}}

subject_variants: Adding the handout to your completion packet
One more thing for {{org_name}}'s graduates
sequence.body:
Hello,

The "Launching your trade business" handout (attached again here) is built to slot straight into a completion packet — one page, nothing for {{org_name}} to maintain. If it's useful, I'd also like to set up a small per-referral fee for any graduate who books a site build through it, so this is a revenue add for {{org_name}}, not a favor.

Reply and I'll set up an affiliate code for your program.

{{signer_name}}

subject_variants: Quick one — who handles student resources at {{org_name}}?
Setting up the affiliate code
sequence.body:
Hello,

Following up in case this landed with the wrong person — who handles student resources or completion packets at {{org_name}}? Happy to set up the affiliate code directly with them.

No worries at all if this isn't a fit right now.

{{signer_name}}

subject_variants: A referral partner for new contractors in {{city}}
Sending new contractor clients your way
sequence.body:
Hello,

I build websites for new home-service contractors in {{city}}, and almost every one of them needs a bond or insurance agent right around the same time. I'd like to send those clients your way and see if {{org_name}} would do the same for new contractors who need a site.

Reply "send it" and I'll send over a one-pager on how the referral would work, or I'll mail a printed copy, free.

{{signer_name}}

subject_variants: How the referral would work
The partner one-pager for {{org_name}}
sequence.body:
Hello,

Here's the one-pager: we send new contractor clients to {{org_name}} for bonding and insurance, and we'd ask {{org_name}} to mention us to new contractors who ask about getting online. No fees, no contract — just a two-way referral.

Reply if {{org_name}} wants in.

{{signer_name}}
